notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Deep Forest Hermit.
description:
Activate Deep Forest Hermit by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deep Forest Hermit enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator triggers.
Resolve the Deep Forest Hermit trigger, creating four 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Deep Forest Hermit.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing two Squirrels, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.
